issues.description: The PersonService.savePerson method has inconsistent visibility between template and solution. In the template PersonService.savePerson is declared public, which is what students expect to call from the REST resource. In the solution PersonService.savePerson is made private while PersonResource still calls personService.savePerson. This creates a structural mismatch that would cause a compilation error and confuses students about the intended service API surface.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore a consistent, accessible visibility for savePerson (e.g. make it public as in the template) so that PersonResource can call it. Alternatively, if the intention is to hide savePerson, expose a properly named public method on PersonService (e.g. public Person savePerson(...)) and update all callers accordingly. Ensure the service API in template, solution and instructions match.
